decision_conditions: The proposed aluminium roller shutters by reason of the overly solid appearance would create an un welcoming and hostile environment, increasing fear of crime and attracting vandalism, graffiti and anti-social behaviour, and adversely affecting the character and appearance of the building, the streetscene and wider surrounding area including the Cheam Village Conservation Area.  The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018, Supplementary Planning Document 1 'Designing Out Crime' and Supplementary Planning Document 14 'Creating Locally Distinctive Places'.
